build_cpm_backbone: build a CPM backbone with 6 stages for human pose estimation on 368x368 images
create_cpm_block: create a CpmBlock with custom channel and kernel configurations for pose feature extraction
run_cpm_forward: run the CPM forward pass on an input tensor to get multi-stage heatmap outputs
review_cpm_stages: review the CPM iterative refinement stages that concatenate previous outputs with middle features
test_cpm_stem: test the CPM stem module that extracts initial features through conv and max pooling layers
